'''Doxet''' was one of four continents on the planet of [[Lazerian IV]].

==Description==
It was located on the planet's eastern hemisphere, surrounded by the [[Caz Ocean]] to the west and the [[Dox Ocean]] to the east.<ref name="LIV" /> The terrain was mostly made up of plains, with forests covering the middle of the continent, while a wild and barren mountain range covered the southern end.<ref name="PLTK" /> The continent was ruled by the independent [[City/Legends|city]]-state of [[Doxeti]], although the [[King/Legends|King]] of [[Kingdom of Devit|Devit]] had a private estate near [[Crystal Valley (Lazerian IV)|Crystal Valley]].<ref name="LIV" />
